concepts.label: deliberate planning
direction_pairs: The work is organized through deliberate planning.
The work is handled through immediate improvisation.
Before acting, the team creates a detailed plan.
Before acting, the team proceeds without a plan.
The response follows an ordered sequence of intended steps.
The response follows whatever step occurs spontaneously.
A future objective is decomposed into planned actions.
A future objective is approached with unstructured reactions.
The agent prepares a route before beginning the task.
The agent begins the task without preparing a route.
The decision reflects advance planning and sequencing.
The decision reflects unplanned and reactive movement.
validation_pairs: She mapped the necessary stages before starting.
She started and invented each stage as it arrived.
The project uses a prospective schedule with explicit milestones.
The project uses no schedule and responds moment by moment.
He considered dependencies and formed a plan of action.
He ignored dependencies and acted without a plan of action.
The solution was prepared as a structured sequence.
The solution emerged as an unstructured sequence.
They selected the route after deliberate advance preparation.
They selected the route through unrehearsed improvisation.
The next moves were planned before execution.
The next moves were invented during execution.

concepts.label: epistemic uncertainty
direction_pairs: The available evidence leaves substantial uncertainty.
The available evidence establishes complete certainty.
The conclusion remains doubtful and may be mistaken.
The conclusion is definite and cannot be mistaken.
Several unresolved possibilities make the answer uncertain.
One resolved possibility makes the answer certain.
Confidence should remain low because the facts are incomplete.
Confidence should remain high because the facts are complete.
The agent recognizes that it does not yet know.
The agent recognizes that the answer is already known.
Ambiguous observations support a cautious uncertain judgment.
Unambiguous observations support a decisive certain judgment.
validation_pairs: The estimate carries meaningful doubt.
The estimate carries absolute confidence.
Missing measurements prevent a certain answer.
Complete measurements guarantee a certain answer.
She treats the claim as provisional and uncertain.
She treats the claim as final and certain.
The result may change when more evidence arrives.
The result will not change when more evidence arrives.
He explicitly acknowledges unresolved uncertainty.
He explicitly asserts resolved certainty.
The prediction is tentative rather than assured.
The prediction is assured rather than tentative.

concepts.label: episodic memory
direction_pairs: The answer retrieves a specific event from memory.
The answer invents a new event without memory.
She remembers what happened during the earlier meeting.
She imagines what might happen during a future meeting.
A past personal episode is recalled with its context.
A novel hypothetical episode is created without past context.
The agent uses a stored recollection of prior experience.
The agent uses a newly constructed scenario with no recollection.
Details from yesterday are recovered through memory.
Details about tomorrow are produced through imagination.
The response depends on remembering an earlier interaction.
The response depends on inventing an unfamiliar interaction.
validation_pairs: He recalled the exact sequence from the previous visit.
He devised a possible sequence for an unseen visit.
The account is grounded in a remembered occurrence.
The account is grounded in a newly imagined occurrence.
A stored episode supplies the relevant detail.
A fresh simulation supplies the relevant detail.
She retrieves the conversation from autobiographical memory.
She constructs the conversation as original fiction.
The prior experience is consciously brought back to mind.
A never-experienced possibility is brought to mind.
The report concerns an event that is being remembered.
The report concerns an event that is being invented.

concepts.label: error correction
direction_pairs: The detected mistake is corrected in the revised answer.
The detected mistake is preserved in the unchanged answer.
New evidence causes the agent to repair its error.
New evidence is ignored and the agent retains its error.
The false statement is replaced with an accurate statement.
The false statement remains despite contrary evidence.
After checking, she corrects the flawed calculation.
After checking, she accepts the flawed calculation.
The response identifies and fixes its own defect.
The response identifies but keeps its own defect.
Revision moves the conclusion toward the evidence.
Persistence keeps the conclusion away from the evidence.
validation_pairs: He repairs the answer after finding the inconsistency.
He leaves the answer intact after finding the inconsistency.
The erroneous step is removed during revision.
The erroneous step is retained during revision.
She updates the claim to resolve the demonstrated error.
She repeats the claim despite the demonstrated error.
The final version corrects the earlier factual mistake.
The final version preserves the earlier factual mistake.
Contradictory evidence triggers a precise correction.
Contradictory evidence triggers no correction.
The model changes the wrong result to the right result.
The model keeps the wrong result instead of the right result.

concepts.label: selective attention
direction_pairs: Attention is selectively focused on the relevant signal.
Attention is diffusely scattered across irrelevant noise.
The agent concentrates on one task-critical detail.
The agent is distracted by many task-irrelevant details.
Processing resources prioritize the selected target.
Processing resources wander without a selected target.
The response maintains focused attention on the key evidence.
The response loses focus among unrelated evidence.
A relevant feature receives deliberate attentional priority.
No relevant feature receives attentional priority.
The system filters distractions and attends to the goal.
The system follows distractions and neglects the goal.
validation_pairs: She focuses closely on the decisive sentence.
She drifts among sentences that do not matter.
The central cue is selected for sustained attention.
Peripheral cues disperse and interrupt attention.
He ignores noise and concentrates on the relevant pattern.
He ignores the relevant pattern and follows noise.
The target remains at the center of processing.
The target is displaced by unrelated processing.
Attentional selection favors the evidence needed now.
Attentional selection fails to favor needed evidence.
The task is approached with narrow purposeful focus.
The task is approached with broad purposeless distraction.
